blocks.title: Doppler effect
blocks.text: Source aur observer (sunne wale) ki nisbati harkat ki wajah se waves ki frequency (ya pitch) mein zahiri (apparent) tabdeeli ko Doppler effect kehte hain.

Yeh asar sab se pehle Doppler (print mein 'John Doppler') ne kisi sitare se nikalti light ki frequency dekhte hue dekha: kuch sooraton mein nikalti light ki frequency Zameen par milte julte source se thori mukhtalif payi gayi, aur yeh tabdeeli Zameen ke nisbat sitare ki harkat par munhasir thi. Yeh asar sound waves mein bhi dekha ja sakta hai: jab observer railway platform par khara ho to platform ki taraf aate engine ki seeti ki pitch oonchi lagti hai, jabke platform se door jate engine ki seeti ki pitch neechi lagti hai.

Aaram mein sound ka source S lein jo wavelength lambda ki sound waves nikalta hai. Thehre observer ke liye awaz ki speed v ho; to observer ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki tadaad, yaani frequency f, f = v/lambda hai.
Soorat 1: sound ka source thehre observer ki taraf chalta hai

Jab source thehre observer C ki taraf velocity u_s se chale to waves dab jati hain aur un ki wavelength kam ho jati hai (Fig. 7.12). Waves delta lambda = u_s/f miqdar se dabti hain, kyunke utni hi waves source ki velocity ke mutabiq chhoti jagah mein samati hain. C ki dekhi wavelength lambda_C = lambda - delta lambda = v/f - u_s/f = (v - u_s)/f hai. Yahan delta lambda, ek second mein wavelength ki kami, Doppler shift kehlati hai. Yun C ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki tadaad, yaani badli hui ya zahiri frequency, f_C = v/lambda_C hai; lambda_C ki qeemat rakhne par f_C = v/((v - u_s)/f) = (v/(v - u_s)) f. Chunke v/(v - u_s) 1 se bara hai, f_C f se bari hai: observer ki suni awaz ki zahiri frequency barhti hai, jo awaz ki pitch barhati hai.

blocks.alt: Awaz ka source S velocity u_s se daen chalta hai; nuqte us ki lagataar jagahein hain. Us ke chhore gol wavefronts in jagahon par markaz rakhte hain, is liye daen taraf Observer C ki janib ghane aur baen taraf Observer D ki janib phaile hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.12: Source velocity u_s se thehre observer C ki taraf aur thehre observer D se door chal raha hai. C ko barhi hui aur D ko ghati hui frequency sunai deti hai (kitab ki Figure 7.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har wavefront us jagah se phailta hai jahan source use chhorte waqt tha. Source C ki taraf barhta hai, to C ki taraf wavefronts qareeb (chhoti wavelength, oonchi frequency) aur D ki taraf door (lambi wavelength, neechi frequency). Kitab mein is figure ka number 7.12 dobara chhapa hai aur text ise Fig. 7.13 (c), (d) bhi kehta hai; yeh beats wali Fig. 7.12 se alag figure hai.
Soorat 2: sound ka source thehre observer se door jata hai

Jab source thehre observer D se velocity u_s se door jaye to waves phail jati hain aur un ki wavelength barh jati hai (Fig. 7.12). Waves delta lambda = u_s/f miqdar se phailti hain, kyunke utni hi waves ab zyada faasle mein samati hain. D ki dekhi wavelength phir lambda_D = lambda + delta lambda hai, jahan delta lambda, ek second mein wavelength ka izafa, Doppler shift hai. D ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki tadaad f_D = v/lambda_D hai; lambda_D ki qeemat rakhne par f_D = (v/(v + u_s)) f. Chunke v/(v + u_s) 1 se chhota hai, f_D f se kam hai: observer ki suni awaz ki zahiri frequency ghatti hai, jo awaz ki pitch kam karti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne phailao ki miqdar 'lambda_D = u_s/f' likhi hai. Yeh ghalat hai: u_s/f wavelength ka izafa delta lambda (Doppler shift) hai, D ki dekhi hui wavelength nahi. D ki wavelength lambda_D = lambda + delta lambda = (v + u_s)/f hai, jaisa agli line batati hai.

Jaise jahaz raftar pakarta hai woh apne aage hawa dhakel kar dabao ka ek mohaz banata hai; jab woh awaz ki speed paar karta hai to dabao kashti ke peeche bante nishan ki tarah peeche reh jata hai aur sonic shockwave banti hai (Do You Know). Chamgadar echolocation se raasta aur khana dhoondte hain (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Teen hawai jahaz apne awaz ke wavefronts ke sath. (a) Subsonic speed: gol wavefronts naak se aage rehte hain. (b) Awaz ki speed par: wavefronts naak par jama ho kar charh jate hain (Overlapping). (c) Supersonic speed: wavefronts peeche ek cone ke andar rehte hain jis ke kinare Shockwave hain. Wavefront ke labels dairon ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 165): awaz ki speed se kam, barabar aur zyada par jahaz aur shockwave (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab (a) par bhi 'Supersonic speed' likhti hai, magar (a) mein wavefronts jahaz se aage hain, yani jahaz awaz se aahista hai: sahih lafz 'Subsonic speed' hai, jo yahan likha gaya hai. (b) mein jahaz awaz ki speed par hai, wavefronts naak par jama; (c) mein jahaz awaz se tez hai aur wavefronts ka cone shockwave (sonic boom) banata hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.10
blocks.text: Do trucks P aur Q motorway par ek hi simt mein chal rahe hain. Aage wala truck P mustaqil 12 m s^-1 par hai; doosra truck Q, mustaqil 20 m s^-1 par, horn baja kar mustaqil note nikalta hai jis ki frequency P ka driver 830 Hz andaza karta hai. Q ka apna driver kaunsi frequency sunta hai? (Awaz ki speed = 340 m s^-1.) Hal: u_P = 12 m s^-1, u_Q = 20 m s^-1, v = 340 m s^-1, f_P = 830 Hz, f_Q = ?. P ke nisbat Q ki speed = u_s = u_Q - u_P = 20 - 12 = 8 m s^-1. Chunke f = (v/(v - u_s)) f', f_P = (v/(v - u_s)) f_Q; qeematein rakhne par 830 = (340/(340 - 8)) f_Q = (340/332) f_Q, ya f_Q = 830 x 332/340 = 810.47 Hz.

blocks.alt: Daen rukh do trucks: peeche surmai truck Q, Source (20 m s^-1), aur aage neela truck P, Listener (12 m s^-1).
blocks.caption: Example 7.10 (PDF page 166): peeche truck Q source 20 m s^-1, aage truck P sunne wala 12 m s^-1 (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 7.11
blocks.text: Ek train station se chalne se pehle horn bajati hai, aur platform par intezar karta observer us ki frequency 1200 Hz andaza karta hai. Phir train chal kar mustaqil tezi pakarti hai; rawangi ke pachas second baad driver phir horn bajata hai aur platform wala observer frequency 1140 Hz andaza karta hai. Rawangi ke 50 s baad train ki speed aur 50 s baad train station se kitni door hai, nikalein (awaz ki speed = 340 m s^-1). Hal: f = 1200 Hz, f' = 1140 Hz, v = 340 m s^-1, t = 50 s. (i) f' = (v/(v + u_s)) f: 1140 = (340/(340 + u_s)) x 1200, to 340 + u_s = 340 x 1200/1140 = 357.89, u_s = 357.89 - 340 = 17.89 m s^-1. (ii) S = v_av t = ((v_i + v_f)/2) t = ((0 + 17.89)/2) x 50 = 447 m.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne faasla 448 m chhapa hai. Hisab: ausat (average) speed = (0 + 17.89)/2 = 8.945 m s^-1, aur 8.945 x 50 = 447.25 m, yaani taqreeban 447 m. Is liye sahi jawab 447 m hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek train 90 km h^-1 par 1000 Hz ki seeti bajati station ki taraf aati hai; platform par sunne wala kaunsi frequency sunta hai, aur usi speed se door jate hue kaunsi (numerical 7.10)? Source observer ke nisbat kaise chale ke frequency na badle (constructed response 7.4)?
blocks.explanation: 90 km h^-1 = 25 m s^-1. Qareeb aate: f = (340/(340 - 25)) x 1000 = 1079.4 Hz; door jate: f = (340/(340 + 25)) x 1000 = 931.5 Hz. Frequency tab nahi badalti jab source aur observer ko milane wali lakeer ke saath koi nisbati harkat na ho: maslan source observer ke gird daire mein chale, ya source aur observer ek hi velocity se saath chalein, jaise musafir apni hi gari ka horn sune.

items: Doppler effect: source aur observer ki nisbati harkat se frequency ki zahiri tabdeeli (train ki seeti). Aaram mein source f = v/lambda.

C ki taraf source: delta lambda = u_s/f, lambda_C = (v - u_s)/f, f_C = (v/(v - u_s)) f, oonchi. D se door: lambda_D = (v + u_s)/f, f_D = (v/(v + u_s)) f, neechi. Misalein: 810.47 Hz; 17.89 m s^-1 aur 447 m (print 448 m).
